author: Scout
details: Actor Scout; task fresh-quarter-minute-feed; common source independently applicable to each PC with its own symbols and manual session.
Archive original one-minute responses and upsert canonical raw and normalized minute history before aggregation or model work.
Use a separate manual-session data worker for exact completed quarter-hour windows; model and scoring consumers read saved working frames.
Latch the Pacific trading date, retry unavailable intervals fairly, save the final 16:45-17:00 window after late publication, then close market-data acquisition without opening another day.
Retain missing native minutes and marked aggregate provenance, causal receipt times, existing model exclusions, and original forecasts and trading records.
limitations: Offline mocked-provider tests establish data plumbing and timing, not model profitability or loaded process behavior.
Native provider omissions remain explicit; canonical history never gains fabricated minutes and the observed-only model retains its exclusions.
Canonical writes serialize within this process; other existing Parquet writers retain their separate file ownership.
Source is based on the published manual-trader/model branch; main integration and peer installation remain separate.
runtime_implications: Jeremy authorized Scout local installation. The new data worker loads at the next human manual trader startup; no process is started or restarted by installation. Other PCs keep their own symbols, bindings and manual control.
summary: Independent quarter-hour native-minute persistence installed; final Pacific window drains before data closure

tests.check: Offline native persistence, acquisition timing/retries, manual startup wiring and model recipe
